caption: The drawing depicts a geometric pattern composed of hexagonal shapes arranged in a quilt-like design. At the center, a group of seven blue hexagons forms a flower-like cluster, with one blue hexagon in the middle surrounded by six others. Surrounding this central cluster are beige hexagons, some of which have brown diagonal lines within them, creating a sense of texture and depth. Along the outer areas, there are additional hexagons in black and dark brown, some patterned with intersecting yellow and pale lines. The left edge of the composition is bordered by a vertical teal strip and a purple strip, both plain in color. The upper section beyond the main hexagonal pattern includes a blue area. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background, and the objects are arranged to form a partial square, with incomplete edges along the upper and right sides, as though displaying a section of a larger quilt.
title: Silk Quilt (Hexagonal Pattern)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
